text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering - token-count drift detected. Aggregate token counts diverging from emitter baseline for multiple customers. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift — please ack and triage

alex: acked, oncall here. I see the alert spike at 08:12 UTC, linking tracer and runbook.

sarah: seeing delayed ingest from emitter-service in prod-us-east. Kinesis lag metric at ~15min. Could be replay/consumer slowdown.

mike: @billing-eng can you confirm if any deploys touched emitter or the aggregator in the last hour?

billing-eng: no deploys in past 6h. We're seeing emitter-producer 5xx retries around 08:10-08:13 in logs. Sample: ```ERROR emitter/producer.go:214: failed write: timeout after 3s```

alex: running quick query to estimate customer impact: `SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM usage_events WHERE ts >= now()-interval '2 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;`

julia: hands-on now, grabbing consumer logs and pod restarts. If Kinesis consumer fell behind, we may have late usage reports that trigger overage flags when backfilled.

ben: flagging potential customer impact: preliminary check shows ~9 customers had transient overage flags between 08:15-08:30. We should suppress notifications if we confirm backfill will reconcile counts.

mike: agreed. Can we put a temporary suppression for billing alerts on the affected accounts? Ops runbook suggests toggling suppression for those account ids in billing-control.

billing-eng: started a controlled replay of the emitter shard backlog (shard-3) to a staging consumer to validate event shape. If shapes match, we'll replay to production consumer with rate limit.

alex: note: do not apply automatic refunds yet. Wait for reconciled totals and postmortem.

julia: I restarted consumer pod consumer-usc-4 at 08:45 UTC; consumer lag dropped from 15m -> 1m after restart. Backfill in progress.

sarah: backfill progress: ~60% of backlog processed. Estimated finish 09:10 UTC at current rate.

ben: suppression applied for accounts: acct_834, acct_912, acct_472. Notifying CS to hold customer outreach until reconciliation. Pinged #support with short note. :email:

mike: added a short-lived metric to watch: `metering.reconciled_rate` and an alert when reconciled_rate >= 0.95 for 10m.

billing-eng: replay completed at ~09:12 UTC; reconciled counts aligned with baseline within 0.6% for top-50 accounts. No additional overage flags after suppression expired.

incident-bot: incident update: status -> mitigated. Root cause: emitter producer transient timeouts causing consumer lag and late ingestion. Post-incident action: run a producer timeout tuning and add extra retry metrics.

julia: oncall handoff: I'm handing off to @alex for post-incident follow-up (postmortem, timeline, customer owner). Alex, you're up for postmortem?

alex: taking it. I'll open a postmortem doc, include timeline, queries, and recommended followups: (1) increase producer retry budget, (2) add upstream circuit-breaker alerts, (3) add a suppression playbook for billing overage flags.

sarah: leaving note to ops: validate Kinesis consumer autoscaling policy; let's ensure consumers get an extra replica when lag > 5m.

ben: closing notes: CS informed, no customer refunds issued, monitoring for 24h. If any customers show persistent overage after reconciliation, we'll escalate for manual credit.

mike: thanks everyone. If any anomalies recur, re-pager. :thumbsup:
